content_sections.heading: MGU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MGU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M. Sc. in Chemistry (minimum 60% marks); Candidates who have qualified with NET/GATE will be given preferences Experience: Research experience in inorganic synthesis and/or self-assembly in aqueous phase will be given preference Age limit: Below 28 years Other conditions: Selected candidate will have the opportunity to pursue full-time PhD at MGU. Work will be in collaboration with CoE-KISTI and IIT Palakkad. Desirable: Qualified NET/GATE will be given preferences Research experience in inorganic synthesis and/or self-assembly in aqueous phase will be given preference

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary position on a project that starts in December 2026 Fellowship is for 1 year initially and will be renewed based on the performance of candidate Possibility to extend next year following a mandatory assessment of performance after the first year Selected candidate will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer

content_sections.heading: How Will MGU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications Interview (date and details informed to shortlisted candidates via email) Interview date and details will be informed to shortlisted candidates via email If shortlisted candidates are many, the selection committee may restrict the number called for interview after considering qualifications and experience above the minimum The decision of the selection committee will be final

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Complete CV with personal details, academic qualifications, research experience and publications Name, affiliation and email address of two referees (in the CV) Other relevant documents, as a PDF attachment

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MGU Recruitment 2026 by Email

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/ Project Associate I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 25 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 28 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 25,000 per month + 10% HRA per month = Rs. 27,500 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M. Sc. in Chemistry (minimum 60% marks); candidates qualified with NET/GATE will be given preference.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidate will have the opportunity to pursue full-time PhD at MGU. Work will be in collaboration with CoE-KISTI and IIT Palakkad.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Interview (date and details informed to shortlisted candidates via email). Interview date and details will be informed to shortlisted candidates via email. If shortlisted candidates are many, the selection committee may restrict the number called for interview after considering qualifications and experience above the minimum.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary position on a project that starts in December 2026. Fellowship is for 1 year initially and will be renewed based on the performance of candidate. Possibility to extend next year following a mandatory assessment of performance after the first year.

faq.answer: School of Chemical Sciences, Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam, Kerala.
